B-01.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN tournament_name LIKE '%FIFA Women''s World Cup%' THEN 'women' ELSE 'men' END AS competition,COUNT(*) AS editions FROM tournaments GROUP BY competition ORDER BY competition

B-02.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS matches FROM matches

B-04.sql: SELECT mens_team,womens_team,COUNT(*) AS teams FROM teams GROUP BY mens_team,womens_team ORDER BY mens_team,womens_team

B-05.sql: SELECT female,COUNT(*) AS players FROM players GROUP BY female ORDER BY female

B-06.sql: SELECT SUM(yellow_card) AS yellow_cards,SUM(red_card) AS red_cards,SUM(second_yellow_card) AS second_yellows,SUM(sending_off) AS sendings_off FROM bookings WHERE tournament_id='WC-2022'

B-07.sql: SELECT match_id,match_date,home_team_name,away_team_name,score,score_penalties FROM matches WHERE tournament_id='WC-2022' AND stage_name='final' ORDER BY match_id

B-08.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS all_goals,SUM(CASE WHEN own_goal=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS personal_goals,SUM(own_goal) AS own_goals,SUM(penalty) AS match_penalties FROM goals WHERE tournament_id='WC-2022'

B-09.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS recorded_appearances FROM player_appearances WHERE tournament_id='WC-1999'

B-10.sql: SELECT stadium_id,stadium_name,stadium_capacity FROM stadiums WHERE CAST(stadium_capacity AS SIGNED)=(SELECT MAX(CAST(stadium_capacity AS SIGNED)) FROM stadiums) ORDER BY stadium_id

J-01.sql: SELECT w.tournament_id,t.tournament_name,w.award_id,a.award_name,w.player_id,CONCAT(w.given_name,' ',w.family_name) AS player_name FROM award_winners w JOIN awards a ON a.award_id=w.award_id JOIN tournaments t ON t.tournament_id=w.tournament_id WHERE w.given_name='Lionel' AND w.family_name='Messi' AND w.tournament_id IN ('WC-2014','WC-2022') ORDER BY w.tournament_id,w.award_id

J-02.sql: SELECT m.match_id,h.team_id AS home_id,h.team_name AS home_name,a.team_id AS away_id,a.team_name AS away_name,s.stadium_id,s.stadium_name,s.city_name,s.country_name FROM matches m JOIN teams h ON h.team_id=m.home_team_id JOIN teams a ON a.team_id=m.away_team_id JOIN stadiums s ON s.stadium_id=m.stadium_id WHERE m.tournament_id='WC-2022' AND m.stage_name='final' ORDER BY m.match_id

J-03.sql: SELECT s.player_id,CONCAT(p.given_name,' ',p.family_name) AS player_name,s.shirt_number,s.position_name FROM squads s JOIN players p ON p.player_id=s.player_id JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=s.team_id WHERE s.tournament_id='WC-2022' AND t.team_name='Argentina' ORDER BY s.player_id

J-04.sql: SELECT a.team_id,t.team_name,a.manager_id,CONCAT(m.given_name,' ',m.family_name) AS manager_name FROM manager_appointments a JOIN managers m ON m.manager_id=a.manager_id JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=a.team_id WHERE a.tournament_id='WC-2014' AND t.team_name='Germany' ORDER BY a.manager_id

J-05.sql: SELECT m.match_id,r.referee_id,CONCAT(r.given_name,' ',r.family_name) AS referee_name,r.country_name FROM matches m JOIN referee_appearances a ON a.match_id=m.match_id JOIN referees r ON r.referee_id=a.referee_id JOIN referee_appointments q ON q.referee_id=r.referee_id AND q.tournament_id=m.tournament_id WHERE m.tournament_id='WC-2022' AND m.stage_name='final' ORDER BY m.match_id,r.referee_id

J-06.sql: SELECT s.team_id,t.team_name,s.position,s.played,s.wins,s.draws,s.losses,s.goals_for,s.goals_against,s.points,g.count_teams FROM group_standings s JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=s.team_id JOIN groups g ON g.tournament_id=s.tournament_id AND g.stage_number=s.stage_number AND g.group_name=s.group_name WHERE s.tournament_id='WC-2022' AND s.group_name='Group A' ORDER BY s.position,s.team_id

J-07.sql: SELECT h.tournament_id,t.tournament_name,h.team_name AS host_country FROM host_countries h JOIN tournaments t ON t.tournament_id=h.tournament_id WHERE h.tournament_id='WC-2002' ORDER BY h.team_name

J-08.sql: SELECT k.penalty_kick_id,t.team_name,k.player_id,CONCAT(p.given_name,' ',p.family_name) AS player_name,k.converted FROM penalty_kicks k JOIN matches m ON m.match_id=k.match_id JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=k.team_id JOIN players p ON p.player_id=k.player_id WHERE m.tournament_id='WC-2022' AND m.stage_name='final' ORDER BY k.key_id

J-09.sql: SELECT a.match_id,m.match_date,st.stage_number,CASE WHEN m.home_team_id=a.team_id THEN m.away_team_name ELSE m.home_team_name END AS opponent,a.manager_id,CONCAT(g.given_name,' ',g.family_name) AS manager_name FROM manager_appearances a JOIN managers g ON g.manager_id=a.manager_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id=a.match_id JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=a.team_id JOIN tournament_stages st ON st.tournament_id=m.tournament_id AND st.stage_name=m.stage_name WHERE a.tournament_id='WC-2022' AND t.team_name='Argentina' ORDER BY m.match_date,a.match_id

J-10.sql: SELECT g.goal_id,g.match_id,m.match_name,m.stage_name,g.minute_label,g.penalty FROM goals g JOIN matches m ON m.match_id=g.match_id JOIN players p ON p.player_id=g.player_id WHERE g.tournament_id='WC-2022' AND p.given_name='Kylian' AND p.family_name='Mbappé' AND g.own_goal=0 ORDER BY m.match_date,g.match_id,CAST(g.minute_regulation AS SIGNED),CAST(g.minute_stoppage AS SIGNED),g.goal_id

J-11.sql: SELECT q.team_id,t.team_name,c.confederation_id,c.confederation_name FROM qualified_teams q JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=q.team_id JOIN confederations c ON c.confederation_id=t.confederation_id WHERE q.tournament_id='WC-2022' ORDER BY q.team_id

J-12.sql: SELECT s.substitution_id,t.team_name,s.player_id,CONCAT(p.given_name,' ',p.family_name) AS player_name,s.minute_label,s.coming_on,s.going_off FROM substitutions s JOIN matches m ON m.match_id=s.match_id JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=s.team_id JOIN players p ON p.player_id=s.player_id WHERE m.tournament_id='WC-2022' AND m.stage_name='final' ORDER BY s.key_id

R-01.sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT g.player_id,COUNT(*) AS goals FROM goals g JOIN tournaments t ON t.tournament_id=g.tournament_id WHERE g.own_goal=0 AND t.tournament_name LIKE '%FIFA Men''s World Cup%' GROUP BY g.player_id), ranked AS (SELECT totals.*,RANK() OVER (ORDER BY goals DESC) AS ranking FROM totals) SELECT player_id,goals,ranking FROM ranked WHERE ranking<=10 ORDER BY ranking,player_id

R-02.sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT g.player_id,COUNT(*) AS goals FROM goals g JOIN tournaments t ON t.tournament_id=g.tournament_id WHERE g.own_goal=0 AND t.tournament_name LIKE '%FIFA Women''s World Cup%' GROUP BY g.player_id), ranked AS (SELECT totals.*,RANK() OVER (ORDER BY goals DESC) AS ranking FROM totals) SELECT player_id,goals,ranking FROM ranked WHERE ranking<=10 ORDER BY ranking,player_id

R-03.sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT g.player_id,COUNT(*) AS goals FROM goals g JOIN tournaments t ON t.tournament_id=g.tournament_id WHERE g.own_goal=0 AND g.tournament_id='WC-2022' GROUP BY g.player_id), ranked AS (SELECT totals.*,RANK() OVER (ORDER BY goals DESC) AS ranking FROM totals) SELECT player_id,goals,ranking FROM ranked WHERE ranking<=5 ORDER BY ranking,player_id

R-04.sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT tournament_id,team_id,COUNT(*) AS goals FROM goals WHERE tournament_id IN ('WC-2014','WC-2018','WC-2022') GROUP BY tournament_id,team_id), ranked AS (SELECT totals.*,RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tournament_id ORDER BY goals DESC) AS ranking FROM totals) SELECT tournament_id,team_id,goals FROM ranked WHERE ranking=1 ORDER BY tournament_id,team_id

R-05.sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT team_id,SUM(win) AS wins FROM team_appearances WHERE tournament_id IN ('WC-2014','WC-2018','WC-2022') GROUP BY team_id), ranked AS (SELECT totals.*,RANK() OVER (ORDER BY wins DESC) AS ranking FROM totals) SELECT team_id,wins,ranking FROM ranked WHERE ranking<=5 ORDER BY ranking,team_id

R-06.sql: SELECT stadium_id,stadium_name,stadium_capacity FROM stadiums ORDER BY CAST(stadium_capacity AS SIGNED) DESC,stadium_id LIMIT 10

R-07.sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT match_id,ABS(home_team_score-away_team_score) AS margin,RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(home_team_score-away_team_score) DESC) AS ranking FROM matches WHERE tournament_id='WC-2022') SELECT match_id,margin,ranking FROM ranked WHERE ranking<=5 ORDER BY ranking,match_id

R-08.sql: SELECT tournament_id,COUNT(*) AS matches,SUM(home_team_score+away_team_score) AS goals,ROUND(1.0*SUM(home_team_score+away_team_score)/COUNT(*),3) AS goals_per_match FROM matches WHERE tournament_id IN ('WC-2014','WC-2018','WC-2022') GROUP BY tournament_id ORDER BY tournament_id

R-09.sql: SELECT g.tournament_id,COUNT(*) AS goals FROM goals g JOIN players p ON p.player_id=g.player_id WHERE p.given_name='Lionel' AND p.family_name='Messi' AND g.own_goal=0 GROUP BY g.tournament_id ORDER BY g.tournament_id

R-10.sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT g.player_id,COUNT(*) AS goals FROM goals g JOIN tournaments t ON t.tournament_id=g.tournament_id WHERE g.own_goal=0 AND t.tournament_name LIKE '%FIFA Women''s World Cup%' GROUP BY g.player_id), ranked AS (SELECT totals.*,RANK() OVER (ORDER BY goals DESC) AS ranking FROM totals) SELECT r.player_id,CONCAT(p.given_name,' ',p.family_name) AS player_name,r.goals,r.ranking FROM ranked r JOIN players p ON p.player_id=r.player_id WHERE p.given_name='Wen' AND p.family_name='Sun' ORDER BY r.player_id

R-11.sql: WITH editions AS (SELECT tournament_id FROM tournaments WHERE tournament_id IN ('WC-2014','WC-2018','WC-2022')), wins AS (SELECT a.tournament_id,t.confederation_id,SUM(a.win) AS wins FROM team_appearances a JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=a.team_id WHERE a.tournament_id IN ('WC-2014','WC-2018','WC-2022') GROUP BY a.tournament_id,t.confederation_id), totals AS (SELECT e.tournament_id,c.confederation_id,COALESCE(w.wins,0) AS wins FROM editions e CROSS JOIN confederations c LEFT JOIN wins w ON w.tournament_id=e.tournament_id AND w.confederation_id=c.confederation_id), ranked AS (SELECT totals.*,RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tournament_id ORDER BY wins DESC) AS ranking FROM totals) SELECT tournament_id,confederation_id,wins,ranking FROM ranked ORDER BY tournament_id,ranking,confederation_id

R-12.sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT referee_id,COUNT(*) AS matches FROM referee_appearances GROUP BY referee_id), ranked AS (SELECT totals.*,RANK() OVER (ORDER BY matches DESC) AS ranking FROM totals) SELECT referee_id,matches,ranking FROM ranked WHERE ranking<=5 ORDER BY ranking,referee_id

R-13.sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT player_id,COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS appearances FROM player_appearances WHERE tournament_id='WC-2022' GROUP BY player_id), ranked AS (SELECT totals.*,RANK() OVER (ORDER BY appearances DESC) AS ranking FROM totals) SELECT player_id,appearances,ranking FROM ranked WHERE ranking<=5 ORDER BY ranking,player_id

R-14.sql: WITH cards AS (SELECT tournament_id,SUM(yellow_card) AS yellow_cards FROM bookings WHERE tournament_id IN ('WC-2010','WC-2014','WC-2018','WC-2022') GROUP BY tournament_id), games AS (SELECT tournament_id,COUNT(*) AS matches FROM matches WHERE tournament_id IN ('WC-2010','WC-2014','WC-2018','WC-2022') GROUP BY tournament_id) SELECT g.tournament_id,c.yellow_cards,g.matches,ROUND(1.0*c.yellow_cards/g.matches,3) AS cards_per_match FROM games g JOIN cards c ON c.tournament_id=g.tournament_id ORDER BY g.tournament_id

A-01.sql: SELECT a.match_date,a.match_id,a.stage_name,a.opponent_id,a.opponent_name,a.goals_for,a.goals_against,a.penalties_for,a.penalties_against,a.win,a.lose,a.draw FROM team_appearances a JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=a.team_id WHERE a.tournament_id='WC-2022' AND t.team_name='Argentina' ORDER BY a.match_date,a.match_id

A-02.sql: SELECT a.match_id,a.stage_name,a.opponent_name,s.stadium_name,a.goals_for,a.goals_against,a.penalty_shootout FROM team_appearances a JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=a.team_id JOIN stadiums s ON s.stadium_id=a.stadium_id WHERE a.tournament_id='WC-2022' AND t.team_name='France' ORDER BY a.match_date,a.match_id

A-03.sql: WITH team_goals AS (SELECT g.* FROM goals g JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=g.team_id WHERE g.tournament_id='WC-2022' AND t.team_name='Argentina') SELECT player_id,SUM(CASE WHEN own_goal=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS personal_goals,SUM(CASE WHEN own_goal=0 AND penalty=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_penalties,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_goals) AS team_goal_denominator FROM team_goals GROUP BY player_id ORDER BY personal_goals DESC,player_id

A-04.sql: SELECT g.goal_id,g.minute_label,g.match_period,g.player_id,CONCAT(p.given_name,' ',p.family_name) AS player_name,g.team_id,g.team_name,g.player_team_id,g.player_team_name,g.own_goal,g.penalty FROM goals g JOIN players p ON p.player_id=g.player_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id=g.match_id WHERE m.tournament_id='WC-2022' AND m.stage_name='final' ORDER BY CAST(g.minute_regulation AS SIGNED),CAST(g.minute_stoppage AS SIGNED),g.goal_id

A-05.sql: WITH apps AS (SELECT player_id,COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS appearances FROM player_appearances WHERE tournament_id='WC-2022' GROUP BY player_id), scores AS (SELECT player_id,COUNT(*) AS goals FROM goals WHERE tournament_id='WC-2022' AND own_goal=0 GROUP BY player_id) SELECT s.player_id,COALESCE(a.appearances,0) AS appearances,COALESCE(g.goals,0) AS goals FROM squads s JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=s.team_id LEFT JOIN apps a ON a.player_id=s.player_id LEFT JOIN scores g ON g.player_id=s.player_id WHERE s.tournament_id='WC-2022' AND t.team_name='Argentina' ORDER BY s.player_id

A-06.sql: SELECT a.starter,a.substitute,COUNT(*) AS goals FROM goals g JOIN player_appearances a ON a.match_id=g.match_id AND a.player_id=g.player_id AND a.team_id=g.player_team_id WHERE g.tournament_id='WC-2022' AND g.own_goal=0 GROUP BY a.starter,a.substitute ORDER BY a.starter,a.substitute

A-07.sql: SELECT k.match_id,m.match_name,SUM(k.converted) AS opponent_scored,SUM(CASE WHEN k.converted=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS opponent_unsuccessful FROM penalty_kicks k JOIN matches m ON m.match_id=k.match_id JOIN teams a ON a.team_name='Argentina' WHERE k.tournament_id='WC-2022' AND k.team_id<>a.team_id AND (m.home_team_id=a.team_id OR m.away_team_id=a.team_id) GROUP BY k.match_id,m.match_name ORDER BY k.match_id

A-08.sql: WITH scores AS (SELECT tournament_id,player_id,COUNT(*) AS goals FROM goals WHERE own_goal=0 GROUP BY tournament_id,player_id) SELECT w.tournament_id,w.player_id,CONCAT(w.given_name,' ',w.family_name) AS player_name,a.award_name,COALESCE(g.goals,0) AS goals FROM award_winners w JOIN awards a ON a.award_id=w.award_id LEFT JOIN scores g ON g.tournament_id=w.tournament_id AND g.player_id=w.player_id WHERE w.tournament_id IN ('WC-2019','WC-2022') AND a.award_name='Golden Boot' ORDER BY w.tournament_id,w.player_id

A-09.sql: SELECT t.tournament_id,t.final_round,t.final,SUM(CASE WHEN m.stage_name='final round' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS final_round_matches,SUM(CASE WHEN m.stage_name='final' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS final_matches FROM tournaments t JOIN matches m ON m.tournament_id=t.tournament_id WHERE t.tournament_id='WC-1950' GROUP BY t.tournament_id,t.final_round,t.final

A-10.sql: WITH editions AS (SELECT player_id,COUNT(DISTINCT tournament_id) AS editions FROM squads GROUP BY player_id), scores AS (SELECT player_id,COUNT(*) AS goals FROM goals WHERE own_goal=0 GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_id,CONCAT(p.given_name,' ',p.family_name) AS player_name,COALESCE(s.editions,0) AS editions,COALESCE(g.goals,0) AS goals FROM players p LEFT JOIN editions s ON s.player_id=p.player_id LEFT JOIN scores g ON g.player_id=p.player_id WHERE p.family_name='Müller' AND p.given_name IN ('Gerd','Thomas') ORDER BY p.player_id

A-11.sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT tournament_id,team_id,COUNT(*) AS matches,SUM(win) AS wins,SUM(lose) AS losses,SUM(draw) AS draws,SUM(goals_for) AS goals_for,SUM(goals_against) AS goals_against FROM team_appearances WHERE tournament_id IN ('WC-2018','WC-2022') GROUP BY tournament_id,team_id) SELECT a.tournament_id,s.position,a.matches,a.wins,a.losses,a.draws,a.goals_for,a.goals_against FROM totals a JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=a.team_id JOIN tournament_standings s ON s.tournament_id=a.tournament_id AND s.team_id=a.team_id WHERE t.team_name='France' ORDER BY a.tournament_id

A-12.sql: WITH games AS (SELECT team_id,SUM(goals_for) AS goals_for,SUM(goals_against) AS goals_against FROM team_appearances WHERE tournament_id='WC-2022' GROUP BY team_id), cards AS (SELECT team_id,SUM(yellow_card) AS yellow_cards,SUM(red_card) AS red_cards,SUM(second_yellow_card) AS second_yellows,SUM(sending_off) AS sendings_off FROM bookings WHERE tournament_id='WC-2022' GROUP BY team_id) SELECT s.position,s.team_id,t.team_name,g.goals_for,g.goals_against,COALESCE(c.yellow_cards,0) AS yellow_cards,COALESCE(c.red_cards,0) AS red_cards,COALESCE(c.second_yellows,0) AS second_yellows,COALESCE(c.sendings_off,0) AS sendings_off FROM tournament_standings s JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=s.team_id JOIN games g ON g.team_id=s.team_id LEFT JOIN cards c ON c.team_id=s.team_id WHERE s.tournament_id='WC-2022' AND s.position<=4 ORDER BY s.position,s.team_id

A-13.sql: SELECT 'goals' AS table_name,COUNT(*) AS rows FROM goals WHERE tournament_id='WC-1999' UNION ALL SELECT 'matches',COUNT(*) FROM matches WHERE tournament_id='WC-1999' UNION ALL SELECT 'player_appearances',COUNT(*) FROM player_appearances WHERE tournament_id='WC-1999' UNION ALL SELECT 'squads',COUNT(*) FROM squads WHERE tournament_id='WC-1999' ORDER BY table_name

A-14.sql: WITH games AS (SELECT tournament_id,SUM(home_team_score+away_team_score) AS match_goals FROM matches WHERE tournament_id IN ('WC-2014','WC-2018','WC-2022') GROUP BY tournament_id), events AS (SELECT tournament_id,COUNT(*) AS goal_events,SUM(own_goal) AS own_goals FROM goals WHERE tournament_id IN ('WC-2014','WC-2018','WC-2022') GROUP BY tournament_id), kicks AS (SELECT tournament_id,COUNT(*) AS shootout_kicks FROM penalty_kicks WHERE tournament_id IN ('WC-2014','WC-2018','WC-2022') GROUP BY tournament_id) SELECT m.tournament_id,m.match_goals,e.goal_events,e.own_goals,COALESCE(k.shootout_kicks,0) AS shootout_kicks FROM games m JOIN events e ON e.tournament_id=m.tournament_id LEFT JOIN kicks k ON k.tournament_id=m.tournament_id ORDER BY m.tournament_id
